title: Size Down
symptoms: my ring is too big
ring keeps slipping off
i need my ring made smaller
ring is too loose
i lost weight and my ring doesn't fit
can you size my ring down
whenToUse: Use when the customer's plain ring is too big and needs to be made smaller by cutting and re-soldering the shank. For rings with no gemstones.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for rings that need to be made larger (use a Size Up task) or for eternity bands and stone-set shanks where sizing affects the stones.

title: Size up (1 size) - up to 3mm x 2 mm shank
symptoms: my ring is a little too tight
i need my ring one size bigger
ring won't go over my knuckle
my finger got bigger
can you make my band a bit larger
ring feels snug
whenToUse: Use when a plain ring is slightly too tight and needs to go up one size, on a thin shank up to 3mm wide and 2mm thick, with no gemstones.
neverUseWhen: Do not use if the shank is wider than 3mm x 2mm (use Size Up 3mm to 5mm), if more than one size up is needed, or if the customer supplies their own gold (use Size Up Customer Supplied Gold).

title: Retip prongs
symptoms: my prong is worn down
the tip of a prong broke off
the metal holding my stone looks thin
my diamond feels loose
i'm worried about losing my stone
a prong snapped
whenToUse: Use when one or more prongs are worn thin, short, or broken at the tip and need metal added back to securely hold an existing stone.
neverUseWhen: Do not use if the entire prong or head must be rebuilt (use Reprong) or if the stone is already missing.

title: Set Stone less than0.49ct
symptoms: i need a small stone set
set this little diamond for me
my melee stone fell out and i have it
set a stone in this empty setting
i have a tiny replacement stone to put in
whenToUse: Use when the customer needs a single small stone (under 0.49ct) set into a mounting or empty setting they already have.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for stones 0.5ct or larger (use the matching Set Stone size tier) or when multiple stones need tightening rather than setting.

title: Set Stone 0.5ct to 0.99ct
symptoms: set my half carat stone
i have a three quarter carat diamond to set
my center stone fell out and i have it
set this stone in my empty setting
i have a 0.6 carat replacement stone
whenToUse: Use when the customer needs a single stone between 0.5ct and 0.99ct set into a mounting or empty setting they already have.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for stones under 0.5ct or over 1ct (use the matching Set Stone tier), or when the shop must source the stone.

title: Set Stone 1ct or larger
symptoms: set my big diamond
i have a 1.5 carat stone to set
my large center stone fell out and i have it
set this loose stone in my ring
i want my one carat plus stone put back in
whenToUse: Use when the customer needs a single stone over 1ct set into a mounting or empty setting they already have.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for stones under 1ct (use a smaller Set Stone tier) or when setting multiple small accent stones.

title: Check & Tighten < 20 stones
symptoms: my stone feels loose
i hear my diamond rattling
can you check my stones are secure
my stone is wobbly
make sure my stones are tight
one of my small stones moves
whenToUse: Use when stones in a piece feel loose or wobbly and need to be checked and tightened, on items with fewer than 20 stones.
neverUseWhen: Do not use if a stone is already missing (use a Set Stone task), if the piece has 20 or more stones (use Check & Tighten over 20 stones), or if prongs are broken (use Retip prongs or Reprong).

title: Clean and Polish
symptoms: my ring looks dull
it lost its shine
make it look new again
it's really dirty
it has light scratches
can you polish my necklace
it needs a good cleaning
whenToUse: Use when the customer wants a piece cleaned and polished to restore shine and remove dirt, dullness, or light surface scratches.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when the piece needs structural repair, resizing, or stone work — this is surface restoration only.

title: Laser Weld
symptoms: my ring cracked near the stone
there's a hairline crack in my band
fix this without removing my stone
the metal is split
my ring broke close to the diamond
i need a delicate repair near my gemstone
whenToUse: Use for a precise, low-heat weld of a crack or break in metal, especially near heat-sensitive stones or where soldering would risk damage.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when the shank is broken clean through and needs rejoining (use Solder Together per Ring or Break in Shank) or when a section must be replaced (use a Half-Shank task).

title: Reprong
symptoms: my prongs are badly worn
a whole prong broke off
the prongs are bent and damaged
my stone is barely held in
my ring keeps catching and the prongs look gone
rebuild the prongs on my ring
whenToUse: Use when one or more prongs are too damaged to retip and the prong or head must be rebuilt to securely hold the stone.
neverUseWhen: Do not use if only the prong tips need metal added (use Retip prongs) or if the stone is already lost.

title: Size Up  - 3mm to 5mm shanks
symptoms: my wide band is too tight
size up my thick ring
my chunky band won't fit anymore
i need my wide ring made bigger
make my heavy band larger
whenToUse: Use when a plain ring needs to be sized up on a medium-to-wide shank between 3mm and 5mm wide, where more metal is required than a thin band.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for thin shanks up to 3mm (use the Size Up 1 size task), for sizing down, or when the customer supplies their own gold.

title: Break in chain
symptoms: my chain broke
my necklace snapped
there's a broken link in my chain
my bracelet came apart
the chain pulled apart
a link in my necklace separated
whenToUse: Use when a chain or necklace has broken or pulled apart at a link and needs the break repaired and rejoined.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when only the clasp is broken (use Clasp Repair) or when a jump ring needs adding (use Add Jump Ring).

title: Break in Shank
symptoms: my ring band broke in half
my ring cracked all the way through
the band split open
my ring snapped
there's a gap where my ring broke
whenToUse: Use when a ring shank has broken or cracked clean through and needs to be welded back together at the break.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when a worn section must be replaced (use a Half-Shank task) or when the repair is a fine crack near a stone better suited to Laser Weld.

title: Size Up (Customer Supplied Gold)
symptoms: i have my own gold to add
size up my ring using my gold
use the gold i'm bringing in
i want my ring bigger with my own metal
add my gold to make my ring fit
whenToUse: Use when sizing a gold ring up and the customer supplies their own gold for the added material instead of the shop providing it.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when the shop supplies the gold (use the standard Size Up task) or when sizing down.

title: Watch Battery
symptoms: my watch stopped
my watch needs a new battery
the watch isn't running
my watch died
can you replace my watch battery
whenToUse: Use when a customer's watch has stopped and needs a new battery installed.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for resizing a watch band (use Watch Link Removal) or for mechanical/automatic watch repair.

title: Straighten Prongs — up to 20 stones
symptoms: my prongs are bent
the prongs are sticking out
my prongs got knocked sideways
the setting is bent and catching
straighten the prongs on my ring
a prong is bent away from the stone
whenToUse: Use when prongs on a setting are bent or splayed out of position and need to be straightened back; includes a check and tighten, for pieces with up to 20 stones.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when prongs are worn or broken and need metal added or rebuilt (use Retip prongs or Reprong) or for pieces with more than 20 stones.

title: Check & Tighten — over 20 stones
symptoms: my pave ring has loose stones
my eternity band feels rattly
check all the small stones on my ring
i have lots of little stones and some feel loose
tighten the stones across my band
whenToUse: Use when stones in a piece feel loose and need checking and tightening, on items with more than 20 stones (pavé, eternity bands, heavily set pieces).
neverUseWhen: Do not use for pieces with fewer than 20 stones (use Check & Tighten < 20 stones) or when a stone is already missing.

title: Half-Shank — up to 3mm
symptoms: the bottom of my ring is worn thin
the back of my band is paper thin
the lower part of my ring cracked
replace the worn bottom of my ring
my ring is wearing through at the bottom
whenToUse: Use when the lower half of a ring shank is worn thin, cracked, or broken and needs replacing, on bands up to 3mm wide.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when the shank is wider than 3mm (use Half-Shank 3 to 5mm) or when only a clean break needs rejoining (use Solder Together per Ring).

title: Half-Shank — 3 to 5mm
symptoms: the bottom of my wide band is worn thin
the back of my thick ring cracked
replace the worn bottom of my heavy ring
my wide band is wearing through at the bottom
the lower half of my chunky ring needs replacing
whenToUse: Use when the lower half of a ring shank is worn thin, cracked, or broken and needs replacing, on bands 3mm to 5mm wide.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for bands up to 3mm wide (use Half-Shank up to 3mm) or when only a clean break needs rejoining (use Solder Together per Ring).

title: Solder Together per Ring
symptoms: solder my ring back together
join my two rings
my ring came apart at a clean break
fuse my bands together
put the pieces of my ring back together
whenToUse: Use when two pieces of a ring shank need to be soldered back together, such as rejoining a clean break or joining two rings side by side.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when a worn section must be replaced (use a Half-Shank task) or for a delicate crack near a stone (use Laser Weld).

title: Sizing Beads
symptoms: my ring spins on my finger
my ring is just a little loose
stop my ring from turning
i don't want a full resize, just a snugger fit
my knuckle is big but the ring is loose
add something to make my ring fit tighter
whenToUse: Use when a customer wants their ring to fit more snugly without a full resize, by adding sizing beads inside the shank to reduce size and stop spinning.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when the ring needs a true permanent size reduction (use Size Down) or when sizing up.

title: Reshape Ring
symptoms: my ring is bent
my ring is no longer round
my ring got squished oval
i sat on my ring and it's misshapen
reshape my bent ring
my ring won't fit because it's out of round
whenToUse: Use when a ring is bent or out of round and needs to be reshaped back to a true circle.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when the shank is cracked or broken (use Solder Together per Ring or Break in Shank) or when the ring needs resizing.

title: Add 18gu Jump Ring — 5mm and smaller
symptoms: add a jump ring to my pendant
i need a small ring to attach my charm
my pendant has no loop to hang it
add a little ring so i can put this on my chain
attach my charm with a jump ring
whenToUse: Use when a chain or pendant needs a jump ring (5mm or smaller) added, such as attaching a charm or pendant or creating an attachment point.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when a broken chain link needs repair (use Break in chain) or when a clasp needs fixing (use Clasp Repair).

title: Clasp Repair
symptoms: my clasp broke
my necklace won't stay closed
the clasp won't open
my bracelet clasp is stuck
the clasp keeps coming undone
i need a new clasp on my chain
whenToUse: Use when the clasp on a chain, necklace, or bracelet is broken, sticky, or won't fasten and needs repair or replacement.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when the chain itself is broken at a link (use Break in chain) or when only adding a jump ring (use Add Jump Ring).

title: Watch Link Removal
symptoms: my watch is too loose
remove links from my watch band
my watch slides around
take some links out of my watch
my watch band is too big
size my watch to fit
whenToUse: Use when a metal watch band is too large and links need to be removed to fit the customer's wrist.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for watch battery replacement (use Watch Battery) or for leather/non-link bands.

title: Size Down — Platinum (laser welded)
symptoms: platinum ring sizing
platinum shank repair
platinum ring too big
platinum ring too small
whenToUse: Use for sizing a platinum ring down. Platinum is laser welded, never gold-soldered — this task carries the weld labor and no solder.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for gold or silver rings — use the standard (soldered) task for those metals.

title: Size Up (1 size) — Platinum (laser welded)
symptoms: platinum ring sizing
platinum shank repair
platinum ring too big
platinum ring too small
whenToUse: Use for sizing a platinum ring up one size (shank up to 3x2mm). Platinum sizing stock, laser welded.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for gold or silver rings — use the standard (soldered) task for those metals.

title: Half-Shank — Platinum, up to 3mm (laser welded)
symptoms: platinum ring sizing
platinum shank repair
platinum ring too big
platinum ring too small
whenToUse: Use for replacing the lower half of a platinum shank up to 3mm wide. Platinum sizing stock, laser welded.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for gold or silver rings — use the standard (soldered) task for those metals.

title: Half-Shank — Platinum, 3 to 5mm (laser welded)
symptoms: platinum ring sizing
platinum shank repair
platinum ring too big
platinum ring too small
whenToUse: Use for replacing the lower half of a platinum shank 3 to 5mm wide. Platinum sizing stock, laser welded.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for gold or silver rings — use the standard (soldered) task for those metals.

title: Add 18gu Jump Ring w/ laser — 5mm and smaller
symptoms: add a jump ring to my pendant
i need a small ring to attach my charm
my pendant has no loop to hang it
add a little ring so i can put this on my chain
attach my charm with a jump ring
whenToUse: Use when a chain or pendant needs a jump ring (5mm or smaller) added, such as attaching a charm or pendant or creating an attachment point.
neverUseWhen: Do not use when a broken chain link needs repair (use Break in chain) or when a clasp needs fixing (use Clasp Repair).

title: Rhodium Plating
symptoms: white gold looks yellow
ring looks dull or grey
wants it whiter / brighter
replate
rhodium
whenToUse: Use when a ring needs rhodium plating: white gold that has turned yellow or dull, or a customer asking for a brighter white finish.
neverUseWhen: Do not use for yellow or rose gold unless the customer explicitly wants a white finish.
